Thermaltake Litepower 650W  The Thermaltake Litepower 550W, 650W and 750W are specifically targeting energy efficient PC systems with lower overall power consumption in application fields, office and entertainment computers. The Litepower Series comply to the latest ATX 12V V2.3 Standard for utmost reliability and compatibility supporting state-of-the-art Intel and AMD processor and graphics technologies. With Over Voltage, Over Power and Short-Circuit protection the Litepower series offers industry grade protection. The Thermaltake Litepower series now offers you all these characteristics. Ultra Quiet Fan Large 120mm cooling fan delivers cool performance and silent operation. Elongated Cable The longer cables enable enthusiasts and power users to properly route the cables in optimal location to prevent airflow blockage. Significantly improving computer system’s overall thermal efficiency, as well as the aesthetic. Utmost Reliability and Compatibility The Litepower Series comply to the latest ATX 12V V2.3 Standard for utmost reliability and compatibility supporting state-of-the-art Intel and AMD processor and graphics technologies. Massive and Dedicated +12V Output Litepower 650W is equipped with a powerful +12V rail, please see the output specification on the left hand side: AC INPUTInput Voltage: 230Vac Input Current: 8A Frequency: 50HzDC OUTPUT+3.3V+5V+12V-12v+5VsbMax Output Current24A30A44A0.5A3AMax Output Power140W528W6W15WThe +3.3V & +5V & +12V1 & +12V2 ocmbined output power shall not exceed 630W.
